scripts.build:check: turbo run build && git diff --exit-code -- plugins/tipee/server || (echo "plugins/tipee/server is stale: run pnpm build and commit it" && exit 1)
scripts.docs:effect: npx -y opensrc fetch Effect-TS/effect && mkdir -p opensrc && ln -sfn "$(npx -y opensrc path Effect-TS/effect | tail -1)" opensrc/effect
scripts.fix: pnpm lint && pnpm format && turbo run build
scripts.plugin:validate: claude plugin validate ./plugins/tipee --strict && claude plugin validate . --strict
scripts.verify: turbo run lint:check format:check check test build --continue && pnpm build:check
